Repaired it using the vacuum and translation axioms: T-prime minus T annihilates the vacuum and commutes with all x_n, so vanishes on the PBW spanning monomials. Then the exact fixed-T reconstruction statement yields unique Y. Read all current suppliers and Arakawa–Moreau Proposition 3.1 (printed p.67), whose proof makes the same translation-uniqueness reduction. Statement and dependencies are unchanged.
